notes: Baseline AMD64 System V/Darwin caller-saved leaf ABI; zero iterations returns seed without data access.
All state arithmetic wraps modulo 2^64; actual loop work feeds the returned state.
Both variants load bit=data[(state>>8)&mask]&1, then add 3 for bit one or 5 for bit zero modulo 2^64.
Both candidate values use nontrapping LEA; TEST sets the flags consumed by CMOV after value formation.
The RDX data pointer remains live; mask 255 and 256 words bound every 8-byte load within the ordinary allocation.
MCA intentionally omitted: a straight-line extract cannot model the data-dependent branch-path mixture.
The current fixed driver stream does not establish branch predictability or whole-application behavior.
